PDF A null-scattering path integral formulation of light transport
To enable unbiased light transport estimation in general heterogeneous media, the null-scattering formulation (9) augments the medium with fictitious scattering matter to obtain a combined medium where the transmittance between two scattering events (real or fictitious) is analytically sampleable (right).
